filters.q: has:attachment (invoice OR receipt OR fature OR fatura OR fattura OR rechnung)

parameters.content:
## 1. Ingest
Gmail poll every minute, unread + has attachment + invoice keywords.
**Split Attachments** fans one item out per attachment and tags each as pdf / image / unsupported.
Swap this trigger for Google Drive Trigger or Webhook — only **Split Attachments** needs adjusting, everything downstream is unchanged.

## 2. Gemini extraction
PDF and image use different Google Gemini resources (document vs image) — that is why there are two nodes.
Model: gemini-2.5-flash (free tier). If the model list rejects the ID, re-pick it from the dropdown.
simplify=false keeps the raw API shape; the parser reads candidates[0].content.parts[].text.
maxOutputTokens is raised to 4096 — the node default of 300 truncates the JSON.
Retry: 3 tries, 3s apart, then the error output fires.

## 3. Validate + one simplified retry
**Parse and Validate** strips code fences, JSON.parses, checks subtotal + tax vs total (tolerance max(0.02, 1%)), and sets needs_review when confidence < 0.6.
On parse failure the item is re-sent once with a stripped-down prompt. Still broken then alert only, no row written.

## 4. Store + notify
**Invoice Ready** is the single fan-in point, so every downstream expression reads $("Invoice Ready").item.json and both the first-pass and the retry path resolve identically.
Set the Sheets document/sheet and the Drive folder before activating.

parameters.text:
You are an expert invoice and receipt data extraction engine.
Extract the data from the attached document and return ONLY a single valid JSON object.
Do not include markdown fences, explanations, or any text outside the JSON.

Rules:
- The document may be a low-quality scan, a phone photo, or handwritten. Extract everything you can read.
- The document may be in any language (Albanian, English, Italian, German, ...). Keep vendor names and item descriptions in the original language.
- Dates MUST be normalized to ISO format YYYY-MM-DD. If a date is ambiguous (e.g. 03/04/2025), prefer the DD/MM/YYYY reading unless the vendor is clearly US-based.
- Amounts MUST be plain decimal numbers: no thousand separators, dot as decimal separator, no currency symbols.
- currency MUST be an ISO 4217 code (EUR, USD, ALL, GBP, ...). Infer it from the symbol or the vendor country when not written explicitly.
- tax_rate is a percentage number (20 means 20%), or null when not stated.
- Use null for any field you cannot determine. Never invent a value.
- confidence_score is your own honest 0-1 estimate of overall extraction reliability. Go below 0.7 whenever the scan is poor, fields are missing, or you had to guess.

Return exactly this JSON shape:
{
  "vendor_name": "string",
  "vendor_tax_id": "string|null",
  "invoice_number": "string",
  "invoice_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD|null",
  "currency": "string",
  "line_items": [{ "description": "string", "quantity": 0, "unit_price": 0, "total": 0 }],
  "subtotal": 0,
  "tax_amount": 0,
  "tax_rate": 0,
  "total_amount": 0,
  "payment_terms": "string|null",
  "confidence_score": 0
}

nodes.name: Mark as Processed
nodes.notes: Terminal node for every branch. The Gmail trigger polls unread mail, so "unread" is the queue: without this the same email is reprocessed every 15 minutes. Placed last so a failure upstream leaves the mail unread and the next poll retries it.

nodes.name: Test Config
nodes.notes: Inbox the injector sends to. Must be the address the Gmail Trigger watches.

parameters.content:
## 🧪 Test Injector

Click **Inject Test Invoices** to send 5 emails to the address in **Test Config**.
Standalone branch — runs independently of the Gmail trigger above.

1. clean PDF invoice, totals consistent → row logged, needs_review false
2. subtotal + tax ≠ total → row logged, math_ok false, review alert
3. PDF that is not an invoice → retry, then Extraction Failed Alert, no row
4. .txt attachment → Unsupported File Alert, no Gemini call
5. tiny receipt, most fields absent → low confidence, needs_review true

The image branch cannot be generated in code — send a real phone photo with
"fature" in the subject to cover Extract Invoice from Image.
